classification.reason: The product FAQ directly explains how to invite a teammate as an Editor via Settings > Members > Invite, with no refund, fraud, or policy-exception concerns present.

draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out! Adding a coworker as an Editor is quick to set up.

1. Go to Settings > Members > Invite.
2. Enter your coworker's email address.
3. Choose "Editor" as their role.

They'll receive an email invitation, so just let them know to check their inbox. Note that the invite link expires after 7 days, so if they don't accept it in that window, you'll need to send a new one.

Let us know if you run into any issues or have other questions!

Best,
Loopwise Support
